summary: Prefix literal optimization checked only mandatory leading word boundaries, missing the optional boundary in (?i:(?:\b|_)win(?:32|64|dows)?(?:\b|_)). This allowed a false match inside 'ubi-Darwin-x86_64.tar.gz'. The fix disables this optimization when a word boundary may occur before consuming input. Reversing that condition restores the faulty check. The fix adds the selected regression test in tests/regression.rs, included by the default integration test target; default features enable unicode and perf-literal. This is a proposed reversal, without test execution.
